headline: Claude adoption accelerates across drug discovery and developer tools
body: Novo Nordisk is deploying Anthropic's Claude for AI-driven drug discovery while developer communities integrate Claude into autonomous coding agents and learning platforms. This dual adoption pattern signals clinical AI is moving beyond chatbots into specialized workflows where model performance directly impacts outcomes. For healthcare organizations, the trend underscores that foundation models now compete on specific task execution (drug discovery, code generation, agent routing) rather than general capability alone. EHR vendors and pharma consulting firms should expect increasing pressure to integrate Claude-based solutions into discovery pipelines and clinical decision support. The developer ecosystem's rapid experimentation with Claude agents also previews how healthcare AI vendors will package these models for value-based care workflows.
